title: Raise the Shield
setup: The black rook checks your king down the open e-file, and your own pieces have boxed the king in. The line has to be closed.
hint: Two of your moves block the check. Only one of them lands on a square a friend protects.
explanation:
## The Idea

A check along a line has three answers: run, capture or block. Your king has no square and nothing reaches the rook on e8, so you must block.

{{Be3}} blocks on a square the d2 and f2 pawns both guard, so {{Rxe3+}} would give a rook for a bishop. {{Be7}} blocks too, but nothing guards e7, and {{Rxe7#}} is mate.

The best shield is a guarded one.
